stories.title: Six job coaches wanted to help disabled people in Flintshire and Wrexham into work
stories.summary: Six job coaches are being recruited to help people in Flintshire and Wrexham who are disabled or have health conditions find work. RCS Wales is also hiring management staff for Connect to Work, a new programme it is running on behalf of Flintshire and Wrexham councils. The four-year scheme is funded by the UK Government.

stories.title: More than 6,500 fly-tipping cases left open on Flintshire Council’s system, audit finds
stories.summary: More than 6,500 fly-tipping cases have been left open on Flintshire County Council’s system, an internal audit has found. Auditors said the council’s customer records system, known as CRM, logs reports rather than individual fly-tips, so one pile of dumped waste can be recorded several times. stories.title: Health board says there are “no quick or easy solutions” to Wrexham Maelor parking
stories.summary: Parking at Wrexham Maelor Hospital has reached “crisis point and is no longer sustainable”, according to Wrexham Council’s deputy leader. Cllr David A Bithell has asked council officers to look at extra land and park-and-ride options to ease pressure on the hospital site.
